title: Everyday inputs
about: Bank transactions, emails and customer reviews: paste one and the router picks the specialist. To see the memory learn, open five of the Amazon (AMZN MKTP) charges and mark each one's category as household; the sixth then follows your choice. The spike calls them shopping; the memory outvotes it once it has proved right.

router.question: choice: Which specialist should handle this input? Pick the one whose description fits it.
router.none: None of these specialists covers this input.

spikes.description: Bank or card transaction: a merchant descriptor, amount and date, with recent charges from the same merchant. Decides the spending category, whether it recurs and whether it is unusual.
Email: a subject line and a body. Decides what kind of email it is, whether it needs a reply and how urgent it is.
Customer review of a business or product. Decides the star rating, the main complaint and whether the business should reply.
